google_review_notes: Kids app for ages 3-8 (Designed for Families). No login, no accounts, no chat. Every purchase, Restore purchases and the privacy-policy link sit behind a parental gate: tap the lock (top corner of the home screen) and PRESS AND HOLD the correct answer to the multiplication shown (e.g. 7 x 8 = 56) for about 1.5 seconds. Free content: 16 dinosaurs plus Pteranodon (a flying reptile, labelled not a dinosaur), the How big? size slider, the Fossil dig and Shadow match games. full_pack unlocks all 39 animals (22 more) and removes ads; remove_ads removes the banner only. Dinosaur facts are checked against palaeontology references. Roars are made up and synthesized by the app (no audio files, no recordings; the app says so). Ads: AdMob banner only, child-directed (TFCD, TFUA, max rating G), never on game screens; no interstitial or rewarded ads, no notifications, no Play Games, no Firebase.
apple_review_notes: Kids app for ages 3-8. No login. Purchases and links are behind a parental gate: tap the lock on the home screen and press and hold the correct answer to the multiplication shown. Free: 16 dinosaurs plus Pteranodon, the size slider and both games; the one-time All dinosaurs purchase unlocks 22 more animals. Roars are synthesized in the app and labelled as made up.
